study.description: Four daily candle setups on ten major coins, traded on hourly candles (entry at the next hour, on a break of the pattern day, or on an hourly reversal after a dip) and, for comparison, on daily candles. Stops beyond the pattern day, beyond the entry candle, or at 1.5 ATR. Chosen on September 2020 to December 2024, judged on the rest, under normal and doubled costs, with and without a BTC trend filter.
